Cover reads 'Becoming Like Jesus: God's Key To Abundant Living' by Gbile Akanni.

No other book titles, spines, or a stack/pile of books is visible in either photo.

identity.model: Becoming Like Jesus: God's Key To Abundant Living

claims.claim: A collection of Christian books across many genres like marriage, spiritual growth and more
claims.evidence: Both photo 0 and photo 1 show only one single title ('Becoming Like Jesus'); no other books, genres, or a collection/stack is visible.
Cover looks clean in both photos but no shot of spine, back cover, or interior pages to confirm condition.

risks.risk: Seller claims a multi-book collection but only one title is photographed; the rest of the described collection may not exist or may differ in title/condition.
risks.proof: A single photo showing all books in the collection laid out together, each cover visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a single copy of 'Becoming Like Jesus' only, not a collection

risks.risk: Interior condition (missing/torn pages, water damage, writing) cannot be seen from cover-only photos.
risks.proof: Photo of the spine, back cover, and a few interior pages.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used/worn condition, not as new

risks.risk: Possible duplicate/stock photo use by a bookstore reseller (watermark suggests a store listing, not necessarily the seller's own stock in hand).
risks.proof: A photo of the book next to a handwritten note with today's date or the seller's name, confirming current possession.
risks.if_unproven: unverifiable_remote, treated as standard secondhand risk

proof_requests: Photo showing all the books claimed to be in the 'collection', laid out together.
Photo of the back cover and spine of this book.
Photo of a few interior pages to confirm completeness and condition.
response.reason: The photos clearly identify one specific book by title and author, so it can be priced at its worst-case condition as a single copy; the broader 'collection' claim is unsupported by any photo and is treated as not present for pricing purposes.
